anitails_overrides.overrides/.config/hyde/config.toml: AniTails desktop defaults (Tor Browser, Waybar fallback, no lock)
anitails_overrides.overrides/.config/hypr/anitails.lua: AniTails keybinds, wallpaper and bar bootstrap
anitails_overrides.overrides/.config/hypr/hypridle.conf: no lock listener (live user has a locked password)

notes: Only the Configs/ tree is vendored; Scripts/ (installer, deez-dots, AUR helpers) is not.
Prebuilt binaries hydectl and hyde-ipc are excluded on purpose (no opaque blobs).
AniTails never runs the upstream installer at runtime; anitails-hyde-seed copies files offline.
